beats.care: If you live or work in the IT corridor, expect weaker supply and costlier tankers. Fix leaks and store water now.
beats.what: Hyderabad's water board will cut supply to IIT Hyderabad, BHEL, Ordnance Factory and Bharat Dynamics by 20 to 50 percent, until next June.
beats.why: Singur reservoir, a key source for the western IT corridor, holds just 3.7 of its 29.9 TMC and may run dry within a month.

cards.body: Telangana Today says the city needs about 735 MGD (million gallons a day) for 1.3 crore people but gets about 585 MGD. Borewells in IT corridors that hit water at 300 feet are now dry even at 800 to 1,000 feet.

cards.note: Current daily drawals, per Telangana Today.
cards.title: Where Hyderabad's water comes from (MGD)

cards.body: TMC means a thousand million cubic feet of water, about 28 billion litres. Telangana measures its reservoirs this way. Singur can hold 29.9 TMC but has 3.7.

cards.body: Drink makers near Sangareddy also draw from Singur. Their supply has been cut back, and water to chemical companies there has already been stopped.

cards.q: Why is Hyderabad's water board cutting supply?
cards.why: A weak monsoon left Singur about 12% full, so the board is rationing what's left.

cover.label: How full Singur reservoir is right now

hook: Singur dam is *12% full*. Is western Hyderabad's water next?

learn.t: About three-quarters of Hyderabad's piped water comes from the Krishna and Godavari rivers, not the city's own lakes.
